groups.title: Schema Management at Scale
groups.question: Explain how a large organization should share and version its .proto files across many teams.

followUps.Buf Schema Registry (BSR): What do teams lose when they share .proto files by copy-paste or git submodules?
followUps.Versioning gRPC APIs: Why version a gRPC API with a new package like v2 instead of changing v1?

groups.title: Channel Tuning & Keep-Alive
groups.question: Explain how you tune gRPC connections for long-lived, high-traffic services.

followUps.Keep-Alive Pings: Why add gRPC keep-alive pings, and how can bad settings cause the very failures they aim to prevent?
followUps.Connection Pooling Strategies: When would you use more than one channel to the same backend, and what does it cost?

groups.title: Load Balancing gRPC
groups.question: Explain why load balancing gRPC is harder than load balancing plain HTTP/1.1 traffic, and how you solve it.

followUps.L7 vs L4 Load Balancing: Why does a plain L4 load balancer send all of one client's calls to the same backend?
followUps.Client-Side Load Balancing with Resolver: What happens with client-side load balancing when replicas scale down and the address list is stale?

groups.title: Deploying gRPC on Kubernetes
groups.question: Walk through how you would deploy and monitor gRPC services on Kubernetes.

followUps.Kubernetes Service & HTTP/2: Why does a standard ClusterIP Service cause hot pods with gRPC, and how do you fix it?
followUps.OpenTelemetry & Production Observability: Which signals would you collect with OpenTelemetry to find the service causing a latency spike?
